subject: Bank of Anthos

provenance.how_it_was_derived: By hand, twice, independently — never by the extractor this key is used to score.
derivations: A hand-traced dependency map for the same business process flow (June-July 2026)
An independent hand-trace 2026-08-25 that reproduced the same citations, including the 250ms propagation sleep at src/frontend/frontend.py:342-344
provenance.why_this_matters: A key derived by the tool being scored proves nothing. Two independent hand derivations that agree make a better answer key than either alone, and neither used the tool.
provenance.corroboration: The estate also declares its own service addresses in kubernetes-manifests/config.yaml (ConfigMap service-api-config), and describes its services in README.md. Both agree with the key.

deployable_names.why_declared: The key was written in the hand-trace's display names; a fact base names deployables from the operator's --service-map. These are mapped EXPLICITLY here rather than matched by name similarity, which would pair 'payment-processor' with 'payment' and be wrong.

cross_boundary_edges.note: Gates the journey — mints the JWT. Does not execute a step in it.
The synchronous commit point of the journey.
cross_boundary_edges.why: This is the four-hop chain no static analyser is documented to follow: the call site names no target (frontend.py), the URI is built from an environment variable, the variable resolves only in a Kubernetes manifest, and the receiving route is in another language. An extractor that recovers only this edge has done the thing that matters.

cross_boundary_edges.note: Read-back after commit. Staleness opens the overdraft race.
Read model for the customer's transaction list.
The balance check before commit. Critical.

scoring_rules.score_cross_boundary_separately: Cross-boundary edges are scored on their own, never folded into a total with within-service facts. A tool can be excellent at per-file structure and recover no seams at all, and one number would hide that. This is the axis on which candidate extractors are expected to differ.
scoring_rules.cited_versus_asserted: An edge counts as RECOVERED only if every hop carries a citation a person can open. An edge with no cited hops is an assertion — most likely a model deciding a hop exists. Both are reported, never summed. Measured evidence on model-asserted cross-service structure: 0 precision, 0 recall, 39.1% edge hallucination (De Luca et al. 2026, arXiv:2606.26927).
scoring_rules.false_edges_are_worse_than_missing_ones: A missing edge is a visible gap. A fabricated edge is a wrong answer that reads as a finding, and nothing downstream can tell. Report them by name.
scoring_rules.sql_edges: Edges to ledger-db and accounts-db are database dependencies. A tool that recovers only HTTP is not wrong, it is partial — report the two protocols separately.

what_this_key_does_not_cover: The ORDER stages run in. Static source reading cannot confirm it; the key holds structure, not sequence.
Within-service correctness. That is a precision sample judged by a reader, not an edge count.
loadgenerator. It drives the frontend but is synthetic traffic, not part of the business process flow.
accounts-db edges from userservice and contacts. Real, but outside the send-payment flow this key was derived for.
